title: 第25章 美貌村支书第26章 反咬一口
content_zh:
;;
越看这女人越是迷人。
身上还带着一股极为特殊的体香。
让人闻到，浑身酥麻……
村长李长贵见他这副样子，很生气。
“陈大力你有事儿吗？”
“村长，这位是……”
李长贵又是狠狠的瞪了他一眼，那意思是耽误了自己拍美女马屁的时间了。
“这位是王小贤，新来的女大学生村支书……”
“你好你好，我叫陈大力。”陈大力伸出双手，要和美女王小贤握手。
但被村长李长贵粗暴的挡住了。
“陈大力，你懂不懂礼貌啊？见到女性之后，要女性先伸手，你才能握手，哪有男的先伸手的？你这个没礼貌的狗东西，给我滚……”
李长贵暗道：老子还没摸到她的小手呢，你就来占便宜？
不知道在村子里的美女都是我李长贵先尝第一口的么？
王小贤笑了下：“李村长，你先问问村民有什么事情，我这里没事。”
“陈大力，你有啥事？”李长贵没好气的问。
“村长，我们借一步说话。”
“好吧。”
两人到了外面。
陈大力才把情况说了。

李长贵气道：“该死的陈楚，竟然抢你家的房子？我这就找人收拾他！”
“好，我也找兄弟去，这小子会两下子，我们必须联合执法！”
李长贵找了十多个打手，陈大力也找了兄弟和朋友十来人。
两人带着二十多人，赶了过去。
“等一下我……”这时候，陈大力的爹和爷爷也赶了过来。
“爷爷，你来这里干啥？”
陈长海冷冷道：“你懂个屁，陈楚那小子挺能打的，万一你们吃亏怎么办？所以一会儿我先过去，抱住他，你们上去就打他！”
陈大力的爹陈万福点头。
“没错，你爷爷在前面，我在后面，我们两个老人围着他，让他不敢动手，你们年轻人再冲上去打。”
李长贵闻言，挑起大指称赞。
“姜还是老的辣！就这么干！”
一进院子。
村长李长贵阴恻恻一笑。
“陈楚，你这个小畜生，光天化日抢人家房子，兄弟们，给我打死他！”
他刚说完，陈长海和陈万福父子俩先冲了上来。
一个七十多岁，一个也有六十了。
陈万福抱住陈楚的腰。
陈长海在前面拉住他双手。
然后大声喊：“快打死他！”
陈大力的棒子迎头狠狠的砸了过来。

眼看陈楚就要被大棒子抡头上了。
而且他岿然不动。
content_en:
;;
The more I look at this woman, the more charming she becomes.
He also has a very special body fragrance.
Let people smell it and feel numb all over...
The village chief Li Changgui was very angry when he saw him like this.
"Chen Dali, are you okay?"
"Village chief, this is..."
Li Changgui glared at him fiercely again, which meant that he was wasting his time to flatter the beautiful woman.
"This is Wang Xiaoxian, the new village party secretary who is a female college student..."
"Hello, hello, my name is Chen Dali." Chen Dali stretched out his hands to shake hands with the beautiful Queen Xiaoxian.
But he was rudely blocked by the village chief Li Changgui.
"Chen Dali, do you know how to be polite? When you meet a woman, she has to reach out first before you can shake hands. How can a man reach out first? You rude bitch, get out of here..."
Li Changgui thought to himself: I haven't touched her little hand yet, so you're here to take advantage?
Don’t you know that I, Li Changgui, took the first bite of all the beauties in the village?
Wang Xiaoxian smiled: "Village Chief Li, you first ask the villagers what's wrong. I'm fine here."
"Chen Dali, what's the matter with you?" Li Changgui asked angrily.
"Village chief, let's take a step to talk."
"Okay."
The two of them went outside.
Chen Dali explained the situation.
Li Changgui said angrily: "Damn Chen Chu, he actually robbed your house? I will find someone to deal with him right now!"
"Okay, I'll go find my brother too. This guy is very capable. We must jointly enforce the law!"
Li Changgui found more than a dozen thugs, and Chen Dali also found about a dozen brothers and friends.
The two of them rushed over with more than twenty people.
"Wait a minute for me..." At this time, Chen Dali's father and grandfather also rushed over.
"Grandpa, what are you doing here?"
Chen Changhai said coldly: "You know what the hell, that boy Chen Chu is pretty good at beating him. What if you suffer a loss? So I will go over first in a while and hug him, and you guys will hit him when you go up!"
Chen Dali's father, Chen Wanfu, nodded.
"That's right, your grandpa is in the front and I am in the back. We two old people surround him to prevent him from taking action. You young people will rush forward and fight."
When Li Changgui heard this, he raised his thumb in praise.
"Ginger is still hotter than old! Just do it!"
As soon as you enter the yard.
Village chief Li Changgui smiled sadly.
"Chen Chu, you little beast is robbing someone else's house in broad daylight. Brothers, beat him to death!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Chen Changhai and Chen Wanfu, father and son, rushed up first.
One is in his seventies and the other is in his sixties.
Chen Wanfu hugged Chen Chu's waist.
Chen Changhai held his hands in front.
Then he shouted: "Hit him to death!"
Chen Dali's stick hit him hard head on.
Seeing that Chen Chu was about to be hit on the head with a big stick.
And he remained unmoved.
